notes: Patrician house (3×3, D-054; tier language: dressed stone, ornament, towers — still warm): three storeys on a paved plot — a dressed warm-stone ground floor with quoins and an arched door flanked by brass lamps, two plastered upper floors (the first jettied) between pale stone string courses, framed glazed windows with sills (shuttered on the first floor), a balcony with an iron railing, two dormers and chimney stacks with pots on a hipped terracotta roof. v0 a square tower at the back right rising a storey above the roof under a pyramid roof with a brass finial; v1 a loggia (columned arcade with a balustraded terrace and planters) in front of a wider ochre house (a terrace door instead of the balcony); v2 a round corner turret on corbels with a conical roof and a centred oriel on corbels instead of the balcony.
